events.title: Most of Quant's opening buys didn't fill
events.text: Quant's monthly rebalance sent 209 buy orders into the Nov 2 opening auction, and only 16 filled. Paper-trading fills don't always behave like real-market fills, and most of these opening-auction orders came back unfilled. All 193 missed buys were re-sent for the Nov 3 open. From now on, any Quant or Longterm buy the opening auction misses is bought once at market right after the open (9:30-10:30 ET), with every risk limit still applied.
